preliminary.method: Separate persistent workers, frozen baseline Python, original/candidate native PE; sequential GPU/CPU calls; nonexclusive host.
preliminary.scope: Complete public mixture including all state/weight transfers; or predict/PR/mixture/ESS/conditional B60 resample/estimate and continuous five epochs. Initialization/restoration/IPC/hash/input setup excluded.
preliminary.warmups: One call per batch, or one call per process per paired round; each timed call is restored first.

precision: Coordinate subtraction, square, x/y/z additions, 0.5 multiply/divide/log_mix subtraction use explicit FP64 RN nodes. NumPy exp/log and component reductions retained. No particle/component/precision/threshold/RNG/model/tolerance change.
limitations: Synthetic mixture-guided PF on a nonexclusive host. GPU route only for 2-4 components, >65536 particle-components, finite sigma squared and all finite particle coordinates under ordinary NumPy policies. Older bindings and exceptional cases retain D189 CPU paths. Long real-data positioning error not newly evaluated.
